independent_calculation.cost_method: Decimal service cost_per_teu_usd multiplied by cargo_teu; each leg rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP; preserved-prefix cost included; no real shared booking cost/availability inferred.
independent_calculation.global_optimality: Not claimed. Feasibility evidence concerns explicitly stated candidate routes checked against configured max_hops, horizon and departure bounds; this is not an exhaustive proof that no other routes exist.
independent_calculation.recovery_semantics: Suspension applies only to departures of the targeted service inside the interval; other services remain available. Feasible routes are checked within configured hop, horizon and departure limits.
independent_calculation.service_schedule_model: UTC epoch 2025-01-01; departure times are anchor_day + integer multiples of canonical departure_frequency_days; SC-001/SC-008 check the original remaining suffix while SC-004 enumerates canonical directed service paths and independently schedules the first permitted departure at each step.

review_notes: VERIFIED means the stated event, full impact cohort and listed feasible reference route calculations were independently reproduced under modeled constraints. It does not assert Phase 4 route optimality, real-world vessel availability or shared booking capacity.

verification_method.author_role: Student verification against the frozen modeled dataset and stated rules; no maritime expert review claimed.
verification_method.method: Independent reconstruction from raw canonical shipment, route-plan, service and port records using Decimal timestamp arithmetic. SC-001/SC-008 preserve the original remaining suffix; SC-004 uses a separate bounded DFS over directed canonical services. All schedule and constraint evidence is recomputed. No Phase 3/4 modules or saved execution outputs are read during generation.
